title: n8n Read/Write Files node fails with 'Access to the file is not allowed' after upgrading to 2.0
symptoms: Access to the file is not allowed. Allowed paths: /home/node/.n8n-files
Mounted volume paths that worked in 1.x are rejected
Read Binary Files node fails on the same paths
cause: n8n 2.0 sets N8N_RESTRICT_FILE_ACCESS_TO to ~/.n8n-files by default, so file nodes refuse paths outside it.
fix: Mount data under /home/node/.n8n-files, or list the extra directories in N8N_RESTRICT_FILE_ACCESS_TO separated by semicolons.
